modmenu.descriptionTranslation.survive-t: Start in a Nether Crimson Forest and survive your way back to the Overworld.
gamerule.doNetherSpawn.description: Controls whether new players and players without active spawn points spawn in the Nether.
advancements.survive-the-nether.root.des: Wake up in the Crimson Forest wondering where the grass went.
advancements.survive-the-nether.drip_or_: Put on gold armor so the Piglin squad doesn't jump you (+100 aura).
advancements.survive-the-nether.hard_out: Craft and slurp down mushroom stew so you don't starve on day one.
advancements.survive-the-nether.strider_: Slap a Warped Fungus on a Stick and cruise across the lava lake with zero stress.
advancements.survive-the-nether.give_me_: Throw gold ingots at Piglins until they stop giving you gravel and drop obsidian.
advancements.survive-the-nether.certifie: Crack open a loot chest inside a Bastion Remnant like a certified menace.
advancements.survive-the-nether.locked_i: Fully juice a Respawn Anchor with 4 glowstone blocks to cement your base checkpoint.
advancements.survive-the-nether.touched_: Step into the Overworld for the first time and touch grass!
message.survive-the-nether.welcome_subti: No grass in sight. Lock in and escape!
message.survive-the-nether.welcome_chat_: >> Bro really woke up in the Nether!
[Tip] Punch crimson trees for wood, mine blackstone, wear gold boots and barter with Piglins to escape.
message.survive-the-nether.returned_to_t: Bro got sent right back to the trenches.
message.survive-the-nether.anchor_deplet: Your anchor ran out of juice! Sent back to the main spawn.
tooltip.survive-the-nether.nether_compas: Points straight back to your Nether base
